definitions.short: a rock (Job 28:10); also a form (as if pressed out)
definitions.full: H6699. tsurah [ צוּרָה ] noun feminine form, fashion ; — construct צוּרַת Ezek 43:11 see foregoing; suffix צוּרַתוֺ 43:11 ( מִצְוֺתָיו ᵐ5 , so Co, or תּוֺרֹתָיו , so Berthol Krae; Toy as MT); so also Kt 43:11 ; 43:11 (Qr plural suffix צוּרֹתָיו ) 2nd of these strike out as dittograph all moderns; 1st read as Kt Co Berthol, as Qr Toy; singular suffix צוּרָם (Ges § 91 e Kö ii.1, 440 ) Psa 49:15 Qr (Kt צירם ) their form (of the dead).
